processDefinition.name: credit_score_monthly
processDefinition.description: 信贷评分月度计算DAG：从loan_application申请数据与customer_profile客户画像计算信用评分，写入credit_score表

taskDefinitionList.name: extract_loan_application
taskDefinitionList.description: 抽取当月loan_application申请数据到临时表tmp_credit_app_src

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_credit_app_src SELECT application_id, customer_id, apply_amount, apply_term, product_type, credit_score_id, applied_at, approval_status FROM ${db_finance}.loan_application WHERE DATE_FORMAT(applied_at, '%Y-%m') = '${biz_month}';

taskDefinitionList.name: extract_customer_profile
taskDefinitionList.description: 抽取最新customer_profile客户画像指标到临时表tmp_credit_profile_src

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_credit_profile_src SELECT p.customer_id, p.age, p.income_monthly, p.asset_total, p.debt_total, p.overdue_cnt_12m, p.credit_utilization, p.computed_at FROM ${db_finance}.customer_profile p INNER JOIN (SELECT customer_id, MAX(computed_at) AS max_computed_at FROM ${db_finance}.customer_profile WHERE computed_at < DATE_ADD(CONCAT('${biz_month}', '-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY customer_id) latest ON p.customer_id = latest.customer_id AND p.computed_at = latest.max_computed_at;

taskDefinitionList.name: compute_credit_score
taskDefinitionList.description: 根据客户画像与申请数据计算信用评分：评分卡模型(年龄/收入/资产/负债/逾期/额度使用率)

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.tmp_credit_score_calc SELECT a.application_id, a.customer_id, ROUND( 300 + CASE WHEN p.age BETWEEN 25 AND 45 THEN 80 WHEN p.age BETWEEN 46 AND 60 THEN 60 ELSE 30 END + CASE WHEN p.income_monthly >= 50000 THEN 100 WHEN p.income_monthly >= 20000 THEN 70 WHEN p.income_monthly >= 10000 THEN 40 ELSE 20 END + CASE WHEN p.asset_total >= 1000000 THEN 80 WHEN p.asset_total >= 500000 THEN 50 ELSE 20 END - CASE WHEN p.debt_total / NULLIF(p.asset_total, 0) >= 0.7 THEN 100 WHEN p.debt_total / NULLIF(p.asset_total, 0) >= 0.4 THEN 50 ELSE 10 END - CASE WHEN p.overdue_cnt_12m >= 3 THEN 120 WHEN p.overdue_cnt_12m >= 1 THEN 60 ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN p.credit_utilization >= 0.9 THEN 80 WHEN p.credit_utilization >= 0.7 THEN 40 ELSE 0 END, 0) AS score_value, CASE WHEN p.overdue_cnt_12m >= 3 OR p.credit_utilization >= 0.9 THEN 'D' WHEN p.overdue_cnt_12m >= 1 OR p.credit_utilization >= 0.7 THEN 'C' WHEN p.income_monthly < 10000 THEN 'B' ELSE 'A' END AS grade, NOW() AS computed_at FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_credit_app_src a LEFT JOIN ${db_finance}.tmp_credit_profile_src p ON a.customer_id = p.customer_id;

taskDefinitionList.name: load_credit_score
taskDefinitionList.description: 将计算评分写入credit_score表，含评分来源/版本/有效期

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO ${db_finance}.credit_score (score_id, customer_id, application_id, score_value, grade, score_source, model_version, valid_from, valid_to, computed_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT CONCAT('CS', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), LPAD(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(), 6, '0')) AS score_id, customer_id, application_id, score_value, grade, 'INTERNAL_SCORECARD' AS score_source, 'v1.0' AS model_version, NOW() AS valid_from, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AS valid_to, computed_at, NOW(), NOW(), 'dag_credit_score_monthly', 'dag_credit_score_monthly' FROM ${db_finance}.tmp_credit_score_calc;

UPDATE ${db_finance}.loan_application a JOIN ${db_finance}.credit_score cs ON a.application_id = cs.application_id AND cs.created_by = 'dag_credit_score_monthly' SET a.credit_score_id = cs.score_id, a.updated_at = NOW(), a.updated_by = 'dag_credit_score_monthly' WHERE DATE_FORMAT(a.applied_at, '%Y-%m') = '${biz_month}';

taskDefinitionList.name: notify_credit_score_done
taskDefinitionList.description: 通知信贷评分月度计算完成

emailConfig.subject: [DAG]credit_score_monthly完成通知-${biz_month}
emailConfig.content: 信贷评分月度计算已完成，业务月份：${biz_month}，请关注credit_score表数据并复核评分分布。
